title: CooldownIndicator
description: A  PvP mod that puts a indicator box next to your offhand slot to tell you exactly when you can land a clean hit on another player.
body:
## A tiny PvP mod that puts a lag-free indicator box next to your offhand slot to tell you exactly when you can land a clean hit on another player.
**Green:** You're looking away, still on cooldown, or blocking with your own shield.

**Yellow:** Your target is actively blocking you with their shield.

**Red:** You are fully charged and have a clear, unblocked shot.
## It respects shield blocking angles. if you sneak behind a blocking player, it turns red instantly. 100% client-side with zero delay.
